Computing
\[W^TJ\dot W=W^TJ^2SW=-W^TSW,\]
whereas
\[\dot W^TJW=W^TS^TJ^TJW=W^TSW,\]
hence
\[\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}W^TJW=W^TJ\dot W+\dot W^TJW=0.\]
